claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will be held from April 23–25, 2026, in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
Main events of the 2026 NFL Draft will be at Point State Park and Acrisure Stadium.
The 2026 NFL Draft is a three-day event.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft begins on Thursday night.
Rounds 2–7 of the 2026 NFL Draft will occur over the next two days.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is scheduled for Thursday, April 23, at 8 p.m. ET.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are scheduled for Friday, April 24, at 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are scheduled for Saturday, April 25, at Noon ET.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ABC.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on NFL Network.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ESPN Deportes.
Streaming options for the 2026 NFL Draft are available on NFL+.
Streaming options for the 2026 NFL Draft are available on the ESPN App.
